layout.body:
Subject: Maintenance Notice
Dear Mr. Brown,
We are pleased that you are considering our facility for your mother’s birthday party.
Our maintenance team is scheduled to paint your apartment’s living room on March 11 starting at 9:00 a.m. We ask that you leave the apartment and not return until one hour after the painters have finished at 12:00 p.m.
Best regards,
Anna Davis

questions.stem: What room in the apartment will be painted?
questions.analysis: What room in the apartment will be painted? Bài gốc căn cứ: Our maintenance team is scheduled to paint your apartment’s living room. chúng ta bảo hành sửa chữa đoàn đội kế hoạch trát phấn bạn nhà trọ phòng khách. A: phòng bếp → Sai B: nhà hàng → Sai C: phòng khách → Đúng D: phòng ngủ → Sai

questions.stem: When can Mr. Brown return to the apartment?
questions.analysis: When can Mr. Brown return to the apartment? Bài gốc căn cứ: painters have finished at 12:00 p.m. … not return until one hour after the painters have finished. sơn công tại giữa trưa 12 giờ xong việc …… mời tại xong việc một giờ sau lại trở về. A: buổi sáng 9 giờ → Sai B: buổi sáng 11 giờ → Sai C: giữa trưa 12 giờ → Sai D: buổi chiều 1 giờ → Đúng
